Embedding request with explicit dimensions parameter returns embeddings of the requested size

```rust title="Rust"
use liter_llm::BatchClient;
use liter_llm::FileClient;
use liter_llm::LlmClient;
use liter_llm::ResponseClient;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let request_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"dimensions":256,"input":"Hello world","model":"text-embedding-3-small"}"#).unwrap();
    let request = serde_json::from_value(request_json).unwrap();
    let client = liter_llm::create_client(std::env::var("API_KEY").expect("API_KEY must be set"), None, None, None, None).unwrap();
    let _ = client.embed(request).await;
    println!("{:?}", result.data);
    println!("{:?}", result.data[0].embedding);
}
```
